title: Hidden Commitment Power Is Powerless
abstract: arXiv:2606.02769v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A principal who offers a contract may renege when her default option is sufficiently attractive. The size of this temptation, which inversely measures her commitment power, is often the principal's private information. This paper asks how contracting outcomes change under this information asymmetry. Disciplining off-path beliefs with the Intuitive Criterion, I find that every type of principal behaves and earns payoffs as if she were commonly known to have the least commitment power. Hidden commitment power is therefore powerless, although commitment power can be valuable under symmetric information. The result delivers an unambiguous policy lesson on how to mitigate this information asymmetry prior to contracting: only measures that improve the worst case have value. In an application to credit rating, when the cost of a rating system grows with its number of grades, a rating system that sorts issuers into ordered bands is optimal,

translated_title: 隐藏的承诺能力毫无作用
translated_abstract: 摘要：一个提供合同的委托人在其默认选项足够有吸引力时可能会违约。这种诱惑的大小反向衡量了她的承诺能力，而这往往是委托人的私人信息。本文研究在这种信息不对称下缔约结果如何变化。通过用直觉准则来约束非均衡路径上的信念，我发现每一种类型的委托人的行为和所获收益都与她的承诺能力被共同知晓为最弱时完全相同。因此，隐藏的承诺能力毫无作用，尽管在对称信息下承诺能力可能是有价值的。这一结果为如何在缔约前缓解这种信息不对称提供了明确的政策启示：只有能够改善最坏情况的措施才有价值。在信用评级的应用中，当评级系统的成本随其等级数量的增加而增长时，将发行人划分到有序区间的评级系统是最优的。
tldr: 当委托人的承诺能力是其私人信息并用直觉准则约束信念时，所有类型的委托人都会表现得仿佛拥有最弱的承诺能力，因此隐藏的承诺能力毫无价值，且只有能改善最坏情况的措施才能有效缓解这一信息不对称。
en_tdlr: When the principal's commitment power is private information and off-path beliefs are disciplined by the Intuitive Criterion, every type of principal behaves and earns payoffs as if her commitment power were known to be weakest—hidden commitment power is powerless, and only measures that improve the worst case have value in mitigating this information asymmetry.
